```yaml
name: Database Export

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * 0'  # Every Sunday at 00:00 UTC
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: database-export
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  export:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Export and sanitize database
        env:
          DB_HOST: ${{ secrets.DB_HOST }}
          DB_PORT: ${{ secrets.DB_PORT }}
          DB_USER: ${{ secrets.DB_USER }}
          DB_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.DB_PASSWORD }}
          DB_NAME: ${{ secrets.DB_NAME }}
          DB_EXPORT_PATH: ./tmp/sanitized.db
        run: |
          mkdir -p $(dirname "$DB_EXPORT_PATH")
          # The project should expose an npm script named "export-db" that
          # connects to the database, sanitizes data, and writes a low‑memory
          # SQLite bundle to $DB_EXPORT_PATH.
          npm run export-db -- --output "$DB_EXPORT_PATH"

      - name: Compress database bundle
        run: |
          tar -czf sanitized-db.tar.gz -C $(dirname "$DB_EXPORT_PATH") $(basename "$DB_EXPORT_PATH")

      - name: Upload database artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: sanitized-database
          path: sanitized-db.tar.gz
          retention-days: 30
```
